chapters.title: One Suitcase
chapters.summary: Hollywood, 1935. One suitcase, a few dollars, a room at Bellhaven and a lead at Sunset Casting. By the end of the chapter the Boulevard knows your name.

arcs.title: Getting Noticed
arcs.summary: From a first audition at the casting office to a screen test, earning the gatekeeper's trust along the way.

beats.title: Book a first audition
beats.summary: Talk your way past the clerk at Sunset Casting Exchange and get on the books.

beats.title: Land the screen test
beats.summary: A callback, some experience and the gatekeeper's trust open the door to a screen test.

arcs.title: A Place to Land
arcs.summary: Making rent at Bellhaven and finding friends at the diner: the everyday life behind the ambition.

beats.title: Make rent at Bellhaven
beats.summary: Settle up with the landlady and earn your keep.

beats.title: Introduce yourself at the diner
beats.summary: Win over the counter crowd at The Gilded Spoon and earn a confidant.

arcs.title: The Rival at the Gate
arcs.summary: A rival with her own hard-won ambitions, met at the Monarch Pictures gate.

beats.title: Cross paths at the Monarch gate
beats.summary: First encounter with the rival; standing your ground earns respect.

arcs.title: On the Lot
arcs.summary: Getting work, rehearsing and being seen: extras calls, scene work, wardrobe, press and the Palace.

beats.title: Answer an extras call
beats.summary: Check in with the production coordinator and get cleared for call.

beats.title: Rehearse with a scene partner
beats.summary: Run the scene together and find the rhythm.

beats.title: Get fitted for the part
beats.summary: The wardrobe mistress at The Silver Thimble sizes you up.

beats.title: Give the newsman something
beats.summary: Feed The Klieg Light a story and see it in print.

beats.title: A matinee at The Celestial Palace
beats.summary: Earn the house manager's offer of a matinee seat and attend.

arcs.title: Chapter 1 Conclusion
arcs.summary: All ten quests done: the Conclusion card recaps the chapter and hands off to Chapter 2.

beats.title: The Conclusion screen
beats.summary: A green-bordered title card with a story recap, then back to the Boulevard with "Chapter 2 - Coming Soon" in the quest helper.
